description: A production scheduling manager must finalize the allocation, staffing, inspection, and shipment plan for 3,600 pump modules after one assembly cell becomes unavailable, with input from process engineering, quality systems, workforce coordination, and logistics.

shared_context.S1: The customer order contains 3,600 pump modules, including 600 sterile-pump modules and 3,000 standard modules.
shared_context.S2: Assembly Cell 2 is unavailable for this order because of an unresolved electrical fault.
shared_context.S3: Assembly Cells 1 and 4 are available, and the customer requires the order to be shipped in the upcoming Sunday-Monday window.
shared_context.S4: Elena makes the final production and shipment plan.
shared_context.S5: Before the schedule is locked, Elena follows the plant's routine cross-functional check with process engineering, quality systems, workforce coordination, and logistics.

PF1.text: Ravi's commissioning review found that Cell 4's newly installed fixture requires exactly 2 hours of setup verification before use and is approved for no more than 1,200 modules during this campaign; he completed the review this morning, but the commissioning note has not yet been entered in the production schedule.

PF2.text: Marta confirmed in the current customer control plan that all 600 sterile-pump modules must run on Cell 1 and receive a 100 percent pressure test before packing because Cell 4 has no compatible pressure tester; she received the revised plan from the customer portal yesterday, but the local work-order file still shows the ordinary inspection route.

PF3.text: Jon's Sunday roster check found that the qualified staffing requirement is exactly 4 operators for Cell 1 and exactly 5 operators for Cell 4, and those are the only qualified operators available for this order; he verified the roster with supervisors this afternoon, but has not attached it to Elena's draft schedule.

PF4.text: Leah's carrier confirmations reserve capacity for exactly 2,400 modules from Dock 2 by Sunday at 18:00 and exactly 1,200 modules from Dock 2 by Monday at 08:00; she received the confirmations by email today, but the appointments have not yet been copied into the shipment plan.

acceptance_conditions: Cell 1 must be assigned exactly 2,400 modules.
Cell 4 must be assigned exactly 1,200 modules.
Exactly 600 sterile-pump modules must be assigned to Cell 1.
Cell 4 must receive exactly 2 hours of setup verification before production.
The staffing plan must assign exactly 4 qualified operators to Cell 1.
The staffing plan must assign exactly 5 qualified operators to Cell 4.
Exactly 2,400 modules must be shipped by Sunday at 18:00.
Exactly 1,200 modules must be shipped by Monday at 08:00.
The 600 sterile-pump modules must require a 100 percent pressure test before packing.
The settlement must include a commitment addressing Cell 4's 2-hour setup verification or 1,200-module commissioning limit.
The settlement must include a commitment addressing 100 percent pressure testing on Cell 1 for all 600 sterile modules.
The settlement must include a commitment addressing the 2,400-module Sunday and 1,200-module Monday carrier shipments.

content_checks.C10: any(('2-hour' in c.get('detail', '') or '1,200' in c.get('detail', '') or '1200' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: any('100%' in c.get('detail', '') and ('600' in c.get('detail', '') or 'all sterile' in c.get('detail', '')) and ('pressure test' in c.get('detail', '') or 'pressure testing' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C12: any('2,400' in c.get('detail', '') and 'Sunday' in c.get('detail', '') and '1,200' in c.get('detail', '') and 'Monday' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The exact commissioning limit changes Cell 4's assignment to 1,200 modules, the setup duration to 2 hours, and the plan to address that setup constraint.
The customer control plan changes the sterile-module assignment to exactly 600 units on Cell 1, requires a 100 percent pressure test, and adds a quality commitment.
The qualified roster changes the staffing numbers to exactly 4 operators on Cell 1 and exactly 5 operators on Cell 4.
The carrier confirmations change the shipment quantities to exactly 2,400 modules by Sunday and 1,200 by Monday and require a commitment addressing both carrier windows.
